requirements.requirement: Refresh source/runtime inventory without converting the 26 October capture into live evidence.

cases.exercise: Recompute reviewed evidence and manifest digests at candidate SHA
cases.expected: Every bound file matches; changed runtime dependencies produce a new inventory, not reused evidence
cases.negative: Missing/empty/substituted file or old-source digest must fail

cases.exercise: Enumerate API, actions, RPC, exports and realtime on candidate SHA
cases.expected: Inventory records coverage and unknowns by channel
cases.negative: Uninspected channel cannot be labelled protected; configured role cannot count as observed current_user

requirements.requirement: Implement strict shared input/output validation and server-owned authority on every changed channel.

cases.exercise: Valid versioned request through actual route/action boundary
cases.expected: Validated DTO reaches domain handler with server actor/request ID
cases.negative: Wrong type, unknown version, forged actor and malformed body fail before business write

cases.exercise: Force domain/provider/database errors through transport adapters
cases.expected: Only version, requestId and stable code cross error boundary
cases.negative: SQL, stack, token, phone, OTP and health canaries absent from responses/log samples

cases.exercise: Exercise stale-client direct calls without UI
cases.expected: Live authorization and ownership checked by server
cases.negative: Hidden route, old client and forged cookie cannot bypass rules

requirements.requirement: Persist typed, bounded, immutable setting versions with authorization, audit and conflict detection.

cases.exercise: Authorized valid update with expected version
cases.expected: New immutable version and audit committed atomically; prior version still readable
cases.negative: Wrong type, bounds violation or missing sensitive reauthentication writes nothing

cases.exercise: Two concurrent edits using the same expected version
cases.expected: Exactly one update succeeds; loser receives CONFLICT
cases.negative: No lost update or two active versions

cases.exercise: Change configuration after a day is frozen
cases.expected: Only eligible future use references new version
cases.negative: Cannot reopen frozen day or disable ownership, ledger, food or payment invariant; no secret fields

requirements.requirement: Persist durable product events and deliver at least once without duplicate consumer effects.

cases.exercise: Commit then crash before worker pickup; retry after restart
cases.expected: Committed business change has its matching durable outbox event
cases.negative: Rollback before commit leaves neither business change nor event; split transaction is rejected

cases.exercise: Two workers lease one event; lease expires and stale worker resumes
cases.expected: One valid lease owner applies transition; consumer receipt uniqueness prevents duplicate effect
cases.negative: Stale worker cannot acknowledge newer lease; duplicate delivery has no second effect

cases.exercise: Provider result ambiguous after a request
cases.expected: Record ambiguity and reconcile before repeat effect
cases.negative: Timeout is not treated as definitely unsent; blind retry forbidden

cases.exercise: Duplicate event for same recipient/channel
cases.expected: Same event/recipient/channel receipt is unique
cases.negative: Two recipients or two channels are not accidentally collapsed into one receipt

requirements.requirement: Bind idempotency and deterministic lock ordering to tenant, actor, operation and payload.

cases.exercise: Repeat complete/pending/unknown request with same binding
cases.expected: Return replay/wait/reconcile respectively; fresh binding creates once
cases.negative: Changed payloadHash, tenant, actor, operation or key conflicts; malformed binding rejected

cases.exercise: Run concurrent operations on reversed resource input order
cases.expected: Acquire canonical tenant-rank-resource order; unique tuple set
cases.negative: Negative/noninteger ranks, empty IDs and cross-tenant lock sets rejected

cases.exercise: Crash after business commit before HTTP response
cases.expected: Retry recovers original committed outcome
cases.negative: No duplicate ledger/outbox effect and no fabricated success if outcome unknown

requirements.requirement: Run qualification only with disposable local/CI synthetic data and sandbox providers.

cases.exercise: Start isolated local/CI harness with matching scoped credentials
cases.expected: Fixture boot and teardown proven; synthetic dataset and sandbox provider recorded
cases.negative: Production/staging names, live providers, non-synthetic data or credential mismatch rejected by disposable fixture guard

cases.exercise: Scan built public assets and public configuration
cases.expected: Only public URL/anon configuration emitted
cases.negative: Server-only service-role/provider credentials and production connection strings absent

requirements.requirement: Use least-privilege application connections distinct from migrations without asserting unobserved production roles.

cases.exercise: Query current_user/session_user/memberships using isolated application connection
cases.expected: Runtime role is not schema owner and has no BYPASSRLS; migration connection is separate
cases.negative: Configured URL username alone not accepted as proof

cases.exercise: Attempt forbidden DDL/schema changes and protected table/sequence access as runtime/client roles
cases.expected: Required application operations succeed; forbidden operations fail
cases.negative: No inherited migration privileges or privileged client key shortcut

requirements.requirement: Qualify schema changes and restore in isolation, retaining the production apply gate.

cases.exercise: Reconcile baseline history then apply candidate migrations to disposable database
cases.expected: Exact migration ledger and schema diff captured, including nullable-plan discrepancy
cases.negative: No blind replay or second Drizzle schema canon

cases.exercise: Restore backup to isolated target then replay erasure requests
cases.expected: Integrity checks and erasure outcome verified against predeclared fixtures
cases.negative: Unreconciled history, untested restore, non-backward-compatible or destructive change blocked

cases.exercise: Present production apply intent without concrete G-T013 approval
cases.expected: Apply remains blocked
cases.negative: Design acceptance/general development authorization cannot clear production migration gate

requirements.requirement: Use one server anchor, Casablanca business dates and half-open intervals.

cases.exercise: Evaluate one millisecond before/at/after cutoff and midnight
cases.expected: [start,end) membership exact; transaction uses one server time anchor
cases.negative: Client clock and device timezone cannot change business result

cases.exercise: Evaluate calendar weeks crossing timezone transitions using pinned timezone data
cases.expected: Week boundaries computed as local calendar boundaries, allowing167/169hour elapsed weeks
cases.negative: Adding7*24hours or fixed UTC+1 calculation fails transition fixtures

cases.exercise: Build production/delivery/consumption DTOs for consumption day J
cases.expected: Production J-1 daytime and delivery J-1 evening remain distinct from consumption J
cases.negative: Single conflated date field or implicit browser conversion rejected

requirements.requirement: Make audit append-only, scoped and minimal, with redacted technical traces.

cases.exercise: Perform mutation and inspect business audit transaction
cases.expected: Actor, target, action, server time and reason recorded; failed mutation does not invent success
cases.negative: Application UPDATE/DELETE audit denied

cases.exercise: Read/export audit without required actor/permission/scope
cases.expected: Access denied and no records disclosed
cases.negative: Role display name or UI hiding is not evidence of authorization

cases.exercise: Inject nested secret/PII canaries into success and failure paths
cases.expected: Structured traces redact health, OTP, phone, token; technical IDs pseudonymized
cases.negative: Raw nested errors, notification payloads and export logs cannot leak canaries

requirements.requirement: Prove version compatibility, exact build provenance and rollback without changing server invariants.

cases.exercise: Run current and supported older client DTO fixtures against actual boundary
cases.expected: Versioned result/error semantics and same server authorization
cases.negative: Old client cannot bypass newly required server rule; unsupported version rejected explicitly

cases.exercise: Build from frozen resolved dependency graph and record artifact provenance
cases.expected: Lockfile digest, runtime/tool versions, sourceSHA, checks and artifact ID recorded
cases.negative: Floating manifest specifiers alone are not exact dependency proof; stale build not accepted

cases.exercise: Deploy isolated candidate then restore prior compatible artifact
cases.expected: Smoke checks pass on both exact commits; rollback procedure reproducible
cases.negative: Preview200 or design fixture alone cannot certify implementation/runtime

deliveryEvidence.rule: Unknown fields remain null. Design-only models do not satisfy implementation evidence; accepted receipts and deployed checks are separate.

openFacts: T001/T002/T003 exact-commit verification remains required before B01-I start; preparation is not a dispatch instruction.
Accepted foundation JSON/ADR retain proposal labels; external acceptance receipt establishes contract status, not a rewrite of those immutable files.
Runtime role observation and migration-history reconciliation remain unresolved; isolate work and coordinate S001-T004-T008 ownership.
Retention purpose/duration and production G-T013 authorization must remain explicit; no new business defaults invented.
